name: How should I prepare my home before a paint touch up visit?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a paint touch up visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your appointment, locate any leftover paint cans and check if the paint has separated, dried out, or developed a sour odor. Clear furniture, wall art, and curtains away from the damaged areas so the work area is accessible. It also helps to mark all spots needing attention with blue painter's tape so the painter can address every nick and dent in a single, organized pass.
acceptedAnswer.description: Locate your leftover paint cans, move furniture away from target walls, and mark each spot that needs repair with blue painter's tape.
